headline: Himatsingka Seide Limited: General Updates
sum: General Updates - Himatsingka Seide Limited has informed the Exchange that the Company has on July 01, 2026, allotted 300 Tranche 1 Series D Non-Convertible Debentures at par, aggregating to Rs. 15,00,00,000/- (Rupees Fifteen Crores only),…
detail: General Updates - Himatsingka Seide Limited has informed the Exchange that the Company has on July 01, 2026, allotted 300 Tranche 1 Series D Non-Convertible Debentures at par, aggregating to Rs. 15,00,00,000/- (Rupees Fifteen Crores only), issued on a private placement basis.
